scoring_justification: The paper provides experimental reference values for the six computed quantities; the checker compares the agent's computed values against these with tolerances and ordering check, as re-running the full DFT workflow in the verifier sandbox is infeasible.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for dHvA frequencies and cyclotron masses, plus expected branch/direction entries
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly copied from Table I values for branches/directions: δ, ε, ζ at H∥b and α, β, δ at H∥15° from b to a
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published experimental measurements, verifiable against the paper's Table I.

outputs.description: CSV containing the six required dHvA frequency and mass entries, compared against the paper's Table I experimental values.

output_contract.notes: The checker compares each frequency_calc and mass_calc to hidden gold values with tolerances and verifies ordering within each direction group. Only these six entries are scored; other measured branches are not required.
